The promoters i.e., 'Mr. Salil Singhal and Ms. Shefali Khushalani' & 'Mrs. Madhu Singhal and Ms. Pooja Singhal' entered into Gift deeds dated September 23, 2024, for the purpose of transferring 2,46,00,364 shares and voting rights held by them to their family trusts, in order to streamline the succession and welfare of their family members pursuant to SEBI Exemption order dated August 14, 2024. As a result of these transactions, the said promoter family trusts i.e., RCane Family Trust, Domane Family Trust, Alpha Family Trust and Beta Family Trust were added in Promoter Group category w.e.f. September 23, 2024.
Pursuant to Clause 6(h)(ix) of SEBI Exemption order dated August 14, 2024, the Acquirer Trusts shall confirm, on an annual basis, that they are in compliance with the exemption order passed by SEBI. The said confirmation shall be furnished to the Target Company which it shall disclose prominently as a note to the shareholding pattern filed for the quarter ending March 31 each year, under regulation 31 of the SEBI (listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
In view of the above, the Company has received annual compliance certificate from all the four promoter family trusts of the Company for the year ended March 31, 2026, certifying the compliance with the above mentioned exemption order.
